inputs.style: Entirely instrumental historical strategy game main theme, no human voice, no speech, no lyrics, no choir, no chanting or humming. 72 BPM, 4/4, D minor, warm acoustic chamber orchestra with restrained erhu melody, pipa and guzheng plucked figures, bamboo flute countermelodies, low strings and soft French horn. A dignified, weathered Chinese railway war room at dusk, late nineteenth and early twentieth century atmosphere. An original recurring D F G A C pentatonic motif, spacious and elegiac rather than melodramatic. Six-bar misty introduction, twelve-bar theme, twelve-bar dialogue, twelve-bar restrained rise, eight-bar reflective reprise, four-bar quiet D minor cadence. Natural acoustic depth, understated percussion, preserve room for menu sound effects. No modern electronic beats, no military sound effects or dialogue, no abrupt finale.
